title: Blessings of Fenumion
dek: Find a blessing, explore its three themes, and compare the effects at each tier.
sources: Fenumion 21–25 · all twelve named blessing tabs · checked 17 October 2026 · https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Qk8H3SMq7-8_raesIkaPdNoq4XqgNsJpZRStwlg278o/edit
body:
How to read blessings

A blessing is a path. Each path contains three themes, and each theme has a boon at tiers 1, 2 and 3. Compare the effects below; the cost is shown beside every boon.
